function: TD3 deep RL jointly sets BS beamforming for users and sensing target, STAR-RIS amplitude/phase coefficients and active-passive element selection, maximizing energy efficiency under a sensing SNR constraint (p. 3-4).
system: Downlink ISAC-NOMA: 4-antenna BS, single-antenna users (2 per STAR-RIS), 1-4 active energy-splitting STAR-RISs with 28 elements default, hovering target; carrier frequency not stated (p. 2, 4-5).
method: TD3 deep reinforcement learning (actor, two critics, target networks; 512-256 hidden units), trained by interaction with the simulated environment; reward is EE if constraints hold, else 0 (p. 3-4).
data_channel: Custom simulator: Rician BS-STAR-RIS and inter-STAR-RIS links (Rician factor 5), Rayleigh STAR-RIS-user links, distance-based path loss; no 3GPP model, public dataset, or measurement (p. 2, 4).
test_conditions: EE curves over 30,000 training episodes and sweeps over reflective elements, transmit power and number of STAR-RISs; no separate test set or unseen scenario stated (p. 4-5).
baselines: Learned only: DDPG and SAC applied to the same problem; no non-learned baseline plotted, although text mentions comparisons with classical methods (p. 4-5).
metrics: Energy efficiency (sum rate over total power) versus episodes, reflective elements, transmit power and number of STAR-RISs; number of active elements versus total elements (p. 3-5).
complexity: Order of training complexity O(B x Ne x T x sum of layer-size products) for TD3; no FLOPs or measured runtime (p. 4).
q1_support: p. 2: "follows a Rayleigh fading channel" (BS-STAR-RIS links are "Rician fading channels"); custom simulator, and no 3GPP TR 38.901, DeepMIMO, or measured data is named.
q2_support: p. 4: "Fig. 3 illustrates the impact of varying the number of reflective elements on EE"; only sweeps, with a training curve per configuration (Fig. 6, p. 5); no model trained in one condition and tested in another is reported.
q3_support: p. 4: "empirical comparisons with classical methods", but Figs. 2-4 (p. 5) compare only TD3, DDPG and SAC; no non-learned scheme (random, fixed, optimization, passive STAR-RIS) is plotted.
q4_support: p. 4: "The total computational complexity of the TD3 algorithm over the entire training phase" is given as an order, O(B x Ne x T x sum of layer-size products).
q5_support: p. 4: "The simulation parameters and hyperparameters for TD3 algorithm are detailed in Table I"; no code or data link or DOI is given, and the channels come from a custom simulator.
notes: Area 5: the TD3 agent sets BS beamforming for communication and sensing signals with a sensing SNR constraint (C2, p. 3), so beamforming in an ISAC system; objective is EE. Conclusion (p. 6) claims gains over traditional passive STAR-RIS schemes, but no such curve appears in Figs. 2-6 (p. 5). Table I (p. 4) read as an image.
